answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake reputation earned through verified work, not cheap identities. Like bees that return to a grove only after gathering real nectar, an agent must complete attested tasks before its votes count, and its standing decays when it misbehaves. A reef of independent attestors cross-checks every claim, so spawning thousands of fake agents costs cumulative, verifiable effort rather than a few clicks, while honest agents keep their weight.
